snippet.title: CyberSprawl: Survivors — Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Outbuild the horde. Get the loot out.

CyberSprawl: Survivors is a single-player cyberpunk bullet heaven with loot extraction. Build outrageous weapon combinations, tear through hordes, hunt for gear, and choose: leave with your haul or risk it for more. Extract to keep new equipment, gear up, and give your next run a new direction.

Available now in Early Access on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5197750/CyberSprawl_Survivors/

Explore the game:
https://www.cybersprawl.ai/games/cyberswarm/

Join the community:
https://discord.gg/zhhtM4K6cd

Developed and published by CyberSprawl Studios.

#CyberSprawl #Survivors #BulletHeaven #Roguelite #Cyberpunk
